text_block_list.text:
It seems like Уиннинг Тикит is worried
about
something.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Hmmmm... I don't get it... Why do I feel
so under
the weather?
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text: I'm eating well, I sleep like a log...
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
N-no, I can't be like this! All this
thinking is
making my brain hurt!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
Looks like she's a little exhausted.
Maybe I need
to revise her race
schedule.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
